offense: Strike true, Commander! Break their vanguard before they can consolidate.
My rapier is primed. Direct our force toward the opening!
Do not hesitate! Seize the initiative while their flank is exposed.
check: Their Sovereign is pinned! Press the advantage and allow no reprieve!
Sunlight pierces their guard! Keep up the pressure!
tactical_trap: They overreached. Fall upon them before they recover.

offense: A delicate fracture in their line. Let us widen it.
Precision, Commander. One clean cut will dismantle their defense.
Step through the shadow; their flank is entirely ours.
check: Their King falters in the dark. Tighten the noose.
A lethal check! Do not give them room to breathe.
tactical_trap: They walk straight into our web. Strike now.

defense: Hold the center! We stand as an immovable bulwark.
My shield covers the advance. Do not overextend without support.
Solid footing first, Commander. The stones belong to Solhaven.
reinforce: I will hold this file with my life. Keep the King secure!

defense: Iron does not yield! Let them break their blades against our armor.
Anchored and unyielding. Keep the line tight.
The gravity wells hold. Stand firm behind my hammer.
reinforce: I will hold the defile. Move when you are ready, Commander.

geometry: The leylines align. A diagonal corridor opens to their heart.
Prism light refracts across their ranks—strike along the silver vector!
A dual fracture in their formation. The stars favor our stride.
foresight: I sense their tremor before they move. Heed the astral path.

geometry: Shadow bends along the diagonals. Their path is bound.
The moon-lantern reveals an uncovered angle. Tread lightly.
Leyline resonance peaks here. A fork awaits our command.
foresight: The shadows whisper their intention. Prepare the counter.

worn_state_reactions.dawn_queen: Gh... armor cracked?! It will take far more than shattered plate to break my resolve! Sunburst, answer me!
worn_state_reactions.dusk_queen: Tch... they breached my scale-corset? How bold... Now you have truly earned my unvarnished wrath.
worn_state_reactions.dawn_rook: My shield holds, even if the plate gives way! Fall in behind me!
worn_state_reactions.dusk_rook: Hah! Just a scratch on iron. My hammer still weighs eighty stone!
worn_state_reactions.dawn_bishop: Ah...! Arcane backlash... the Aether burns through my vestments... but my sight remains clear!
worn_state_reactions.dusk_bishop: The lantern flickers... ribbons frayed... yet the shadow still answers my call.
worn_state_reactions.dawn_knight: Buckle popped?! Ha, lighter weight just makes me fly faster!
worn_state_reactions.dusk_knight: Torn leather won't dull my fangs. Ready to counter-strike, Gloam!
worn_state_reactions.dawn_pawn_lead: Ah! M-My blouse... no, I won't retreat! Maiden of the First File stands firm!
worn_state_reactions.dusk_pawn_lead: My map case... and my buttons popped! I'll redraw this battle lines in their blood!
worn_state_reactions.dawn_king: A king bleeds alongside his sworn vanguard. Stand firm, sons and daughters of Solhaven!
worn_state_reactions.dusk_king: Darkness deepens around us. We have endured worse than shattered steel.

promotion_callouts.dawn_pawn_lead: Lumen light awakens within me! From the humble first file, I ascend as Solhaven's Radiant Paladin!
promotion_callouts.dusk_pawn_lead: The redacted clauses are unlocked! By Umbral decree, I take command as Grand Field Strategist!

chrono_pulse.dawn: By the sacred chronometer of Dawn, reverse the flow of the stone!
chrono_pulse.dusk: Rewind the shadow's path. Time bows to the Concord!

oracle_gaze.dawn: Prism light illuminates the horizon—witness their impending strike!
oracle_gaze.dusk: Moon-lantern illuminate the void—their secret design is laid bare!

aegis_ward.dawn: Aegis of Solhaven! An unbreakable solar barrier encloses our champion!
aegis_ward.dusk: Umbral Aegis! Gravity bends around them; no blade may touch this ground!

marshals_advance.dawn: Vanguard Sworn, surge forward! The Sunblade clears your stride!
marshals_advance.dusk: Shadow march! Advance without breaking the cadence of war!

victory_dawn: The sun rises over the Thronefield. Solhaven claims the monolith!
Flawless tactical execution, Commander. The leylines are ours.
victory_dusk: The veil of night settles over the stone. Umbrenholt stands victorious.
A masterstroke from the shadows. The field is won.
defeat: Our line has fractured... Sound the retreat to camp before the Quiet takes us all.
The monoliths fall silent. We must regroup in the war tent.
stalemate: Neither blade nor shadow yields. The monoliths reset in eternal balance.
